register.headline: Couzo's refinements of Kaggle notebook packings at 232, 260 and 307, below T-186, T-225 and T-174
register.source_checks: The issue says both of the source's exact checkers accept all three certificates in exact rational arithmetic, valid and strictly valid with positive wall and pair margins: verify_bound_certificate.py, Evan Daniel's MIT separating-axis verifier with modifications by Francisco Couzo with Codex, byte-identical to the copy the issue-678 packet retains, and exact_finish.py, an exact corner replay. The source's commit of 28 October ends with a Co-Authored-By trailer naming Claude, and the issue says Claude did the certification, the comparison and the report at the author's direction. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit the starting packings to their Kaggle authors, as the issue does: at 232 Alex Chilton's notebook 'Fault-line DP + Basin Hopping - LB 22.2990' (run 362691257, side 15.763381419802), and at 260 and 307 ntumlnoob's notebook 'First 22.268681355 Public Code With Explanation' (version 3, run 362957087, sides 16.638533455862 and 17.979253973651), whose SOURCE_NOTICES.md credits Alex Chilton, David Ellsworth, Evan Daniel and public Kaggle portfolios. Francisco Couzo (https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing) is credited with the refinements only, 1.72e-3, 1.50e-3 and 2.7e-6 of the improvements, by code the issue names: at 232 GPU basin hopping with the overlap-energy kernel of Vladislav Lavrentev's (lightningv08) Kaggle notebook 'CUDA Packing Search' (Apache-2.0) and an Evan Daniel fq polish; at 260 an Ellsworth-style structural move modelled on David Ellsworth's tools, the author's SLP (HiGHS) and the web app's fq; at 307 the web app's fq, a browser adaptation of Evan Daniel's fq optimizer (MIT). The issue calls 307 a refinement and leaves 232 and 260 to the record. Kaggle per-puzzle sides the issue quotes below all three state no packing and are no report.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay and the certificates (stage 4): a clean-room exact checker, the identity against the house's packing and the lineage the source states, a mapped review whose acceptance would raise both rungs. Then adopt each count where it is the smallest validated side (232 and 307; at 260 issue 845's certificate is lower) under the house rule, with both strong generators' regularization and the flip of each new house in the same change.
